note: 1Kgs 10:1 says only that 'the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon'. That she reigned over Sheba is read from her title and is never stated; the corpus gives her no act of rule.
'She arrived in Jerusalem with a very large caravan'
'a wise woman called out from the city' -- the city besieged in v15
'a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head'; he called his armourbearer to finish it so it would not be said a woman slew him
